name: URLHaus
tagline: Malware URL threat intelligence sharing API from abuse.ch
description: URLHaus is a free malware URL sharing platform by abuse.ch that provides an API for querying, downloading, and submitting URLs associated with malware payloads and phishing campaigns. Widely used by security tools and blocklists for real-time threat intelligence on malicious URLs.

auth.details: Auth-Key header required (abuse.ch Auth Key from auth.abuse.ch); free self-serve registration

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free for non-commercial use; commercial use requires paid plan or permission

use_cases: check if a URL is known malware or phishing
look up payload hashes linked to a malware URL
submit a newly discovered malware URL
